book.name: 1 Bhakolinso
book.title: Baluwa ja kutumbula jaka Paulo kwa Bhakolinso

content: Nepani Paulo, nengemakiki kubha mtumi waka Yesu Kristo kwa mapalu ghaka Chapanga, na Sositene ndongu witu,

tundembela mwehapa likanisa laka Chapanga lelibhi ku muchi wa ku Kolinso, bhala bhabhalowakiki kubha bhahuhu kwa kulombana na Kristo Yesu, papamu na bhandu bhokapi pokapi bhabhundobha Bambo witu Yesu Kristo joabhi Bambo wabhu na witu bhelabhela.
Chihomu na chibya kwinu na lukwali, yeihuma kwaka Chapanga Atati witu, na kwaka Bambo Yesu Kristo.
Nhupu yaka Chapanga
Nunchengu Chapanga wangu machobha ghokapi kwa ndandi jinu maghambu ampekihi chihomu chaki kwa indela jaka Kristo Yesu.
Kwa ndandi kwa kulombana kwinu na Kristo mtajilishwi kwa kila chindu, mu malobhi ghinu na umanyi winu wokapi.
Kwa ndandi ulandilu witu panani jaka Kristo ubhonakini wichu mkati jinu,
hata ngachemkepakiwi na nhupu jokapi ja kiroho pandendalela kuhika kwaka Bambo witu Yesu Kristo.
Jombi anaampekya ukangamalu mkati jinu mbaka pakujomukela, nahuli mpata kubhonikana kubha ngachembi na mahoku lichobha lela laka Bambo witu Yesu Kristo.
Chapanga nde ndongwana, ambaju akundohiki mlilombaje na Mwana waki Yesu Kristo, Bambo witu.
Malekanganu mu makanisa

Nundobha bhalongu bhangu, kwa lihina laka Bambo witu Yesu Kristo, kubha njonganaje maholalelu ghinu mabheti kwa mabheti, nahuli ngakwikubha na ulekanganu pachilanda jinu na kubha mbya na ukamulano kichakaka mu liholalelu limu na lengu limu.
Kwa ndandi mwalongu bhangu, mbatiki malobhi ghinu kuhuma kwa bhandu bhakumu bhabhatama kunyumba jaka Kiloe kubha kubhi na kulepa kujongana pachilanda jinu.

Bhela chembala kolongela nde achechi: Kubha kila mundu pachilanda jinu alongela chaki. Jumu apwagha, “Nepani nunjengalela Paulo,” na jongi apwagha, “Nepani nunjengalela Apolo,” na jongi apwagha, “Nepani nunjengalela Kefa,” na jongi apwaga, “Nepani nunjengalela Kristo.”
Bho, Kristo atehi le kughabhanika? Bho, Paulo le akawambakiki punsalaba kwa ndandi jinu? Au Bho, mkabatizwi kwa lihina laka Paulo?
Nuchengula Chapanga kubha ngachenumbatizi mundu jokapi pachilanda jinu nambu pela Krispo na Gayo.
Bhela, nga mundu jokapi joaweza kupwagha akabatizwi kwa lihina langu.
Ena kabhete nakumbatizi Stefana papamu na bhandu bha munyumba jaki, nambu nyonjeka ja bhanihabha, ngachengomboka ngati nakumbatizi mundu jongi jokapi.
Kwa ndandi Kristo ngacheandumike kubatiza, nambu kutangaza Malobhi Manyahi, wala nga kwa mbulau ya malobhi, nahuli kupotela kwaka Kristo punsalaba ngakwikubha kwa waka.
Kristo nde makili na mbulau jaka Chapanga

Kwa ndandi ubholu kubhokana na kupotela kwaka Kristo punsalaba nde lijambu la king'ang'a kwa bhala bhabhabhi munkumbu wa kuhobha, nambu kwitu tepani tetubhi mu indela ja ukengaleku, ubholu ghonihoghu nde makili ghaka Chapanga.
Malembu Mahuhu ghapwagha,

content.text: na malangu ghabhu bhabhabhi na malangu ananaghakanaje.”

content: Bho, abhi kwaku joabhi na mbulau? Bho, abhi kwaku mlemba? Bho, abhi kwaku joalongela malobhi gha mbulau wa machobha ghane? Bho, Chapanga le ngacheajitei mbulau ja ndema ghoni kubha ung'ang'a?

Kwa ndandi kwa mbulau jaka Chapanga, akabhatendiki bhandu ngabhummanya jombi kwa mbulau yabhu bhene. Badala jaki ikamnyambihi Chapanga kubhakengalela bhala bhabhahobhalela kwa indela ja chela ambachu bhabhabhi na mbulau bhachibhona kubha nde ung'ang'a, yani lilobhi lela letulitangize.
Kwa ndandi Bhayahude bhapala nginyulila, na Bhagiliki bhalonda mbulau.
Nambu tepani tuntangaza Kristo, joakawambakike punsalaba. Kwa Bhayahude nde kihibhalakilu, na kwa Bhagiliki nde ung'ang'a,
nambu kwa bhandu bhala bhabhalowakiki na Chapanga, Bhayahude na Bhagiliki, Kristo nde makili ghaka Chapanga na mbulau jaka Chapanga.
Kwa ndandi ung'ang'a waka Chapanga ubhi na mbulau nakanopi kupeta mbulau ja bhandu, na uzaifu waka Chapanga ubhi na makili nakanopi kupeta wa bhandu.

Bhalongu bhangu, mkombukaje chikahi pamukalowakiki, bhamaheli bhinu bhakabhi nga mbulau hata kwa maholalelu gha bhandu, bhamaheli bhakabhi nga bhandu bhabhabhi na makili au bhandu bhabhabhi na yeu bhabhalowakike.
Nambu Chapanga akaihawili hindu ing'ang'a ya ndema nahuli iwezaje kuipoha lihamu yeibhi na mbulau, na Chapanga akaihawili hindu zaifu ya ndema ghoni nahuli iwezaje kuipoha lihamu yeibhi na makili.

Kabheti Chapanga akaihawili hindu yeizalauliwa na kukanakika na yeibhonikana kubha ngacheibhi na chindu, nahuli kuitenda hindu yela yeibhonikana na bhandu kubha nde yeipalika ibya nga chindu chokapi mu maholalelu gha bhandu.
Bhela mundu jokapi ngaalilumbalila chindu chokapi chela palongi jaka Chapanga.
Nambu Chapanga andombanishi mwehapa na Kristo Yesu, na Chapanga antendiki Kristo abya mbulau jitu. Kwa indela jaki tepani tujetakalewa na Chapanga, tukubha bhahuhu na kukombulewa.
Bhela, ngati moilembakike mu Malembu Mahuhu, “Jola joalilumbalila na alilumbalya kwa ndandi ja chela cheatendiki Bambo.”
